recognize_zh: 這是 IGH 重排的 PCR 引子設計示意圖：上方為 IGHV（FR1–FR3、CDR1–2）、CDR3（IGHD）與 IGHJ（FR4），下方 A/B/C 三種策略以箭頭代表引子、雙色球代表探針，病人特異性（allele-specific）引子或探針都落在 CDR3。
features: Schematic diagram of a rearranged IGH gene (IGHV-IGHD-IGHJ), not a morphologic image
Orange arrows/probe represent patient-specific (ASO) primers or probes located in CDR3
Blue arrows/probes represent consensus primers/probes in IGHV FR regions or IGHJ
Three configurations (A-C) of real-time quantitative PCR for MRD detection
describe_en: This schematic (Ghia, Hematology 2012) illustrates allele-specific oligonucleotide real-time quantitative PCR (ASO-RQ-PCR) strategies for minimal residual disease detection in CLL. The clonal IGH rearrangement is drawn with IGHV framework and CDR regions, the junctional CDR3 containing IGHD, and IGHJ/FR4. In approaches A and B, a patient-specific primer in CDR3 is combined with a consensus primer and a consensus hydrolysis probe in IGHJ or IGHV; in approach C, the patient-specific sequence is used as the probe between consensus IGHV and IGHJ primers. No morphologic interpretation is applicable.
